errors.evidence: The provided list of countries on the x-axis is incomplete. It omits several countries that are present in the chart, including Ирландия (Ireland), Литва (Lithuania), Полша (Poland), Норвегия (Norway), Монтенегро (Montenegro), and Сърбия (Serbia).
The vertical axis is labeled with numbers from 0 to 50, but there is no '%' symbol present on the axis itself.

errors.text_span: Най-ниската стойност е 15%, обслужвана от България и Чехия
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The lowest value is for Slovenia (Словения) at approximately 12%. Bulgaria's (България) value is high, around 34%. Czechia's (Чехия) value is approximately 13%, not 15%.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за Франция, Австрия, Испания и Нидерландия са с приблизително еднаква височина около 30%.
errors.evidence: The bars for these countries do not have approximately the same height. Their values are approximately: France (Франция) ~21%, Austria (Австрия) ~16%, Spain (Испания) ~30%, and Netherlands (Нидерландия) ~16%. Only Spain is near 30%.
